meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 当你让它处理 Git 时,它会先分辨你想提交代码、改写历史还是查历史;提交时把多个文件按逻辑拆成若干小提交,并参考仓库最近提交风格;查历史则定位到具体提交。
howto.when: 当对话涉及任何 Git 操作时触发;常见进入点是你说 commit、rebase、squash 等词,或问某段代码是谁、何时写的这类历史问题。

say.text: 把这些改动整理成多个清晰的提交
say.note: 会先输出提交计划,再逐个执行。

say.text: 把这几个提交用 rebase 压成一个
say.note: 会进入改写历史流程,先检查是否安全。

say.text: 查一下这段代码是哪个提交、谁改的
say.note: 会定位到具体提交,并解释改动来源。

howto.what_en: Handling Git, it first determines if you want to commit, rewrite history, or find history. It splits multi-file changes into small focused commits and follows repo commit style; for lookups, it locates the exact commit.
howto.when_en: For any Git operation. Triggers include saying 'commit', 'rebase' or 'squash', and asking who wrote or when a line was added.

say_en.text: Split my changes into clear commits.
say_en.note: It prints a plan, then commits one by one.
Enters history-rewrite flow and checks safety.

say_en.text: Find which commit/author changed this line.
